design.centerpiece: Large-scale cinematic imagery featuring surreal, high-fidelity 3D environments with a 'floating' perspective.
design.mood: Cinematic, mysterious, and high-end creative, blending brutalist typography with dreamlike surrealist art.
guardrails: Don't use vibrant or neon colors; keep the palette grounded in deep earth tones and shadows.
Avoid standard sans-serif weights for headlines; use ultra-heavy weights or expressive serifs.
Don't use harsh borders; use soft gradients and subtle translucency for containment.
Avoid fast or bouncy animations; maintain a slow, cinematic pace.

typography.body: Inter, sans-serif regular with tight tracking
typography.display: Calyx, serif italic mixed with Neue Haas Grotesk Bold
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, small caps for navigational elements and labels

design.motion: Slow parallax on background images and subtle fade-ins for text. Typography should use a 'letter-by-letter' reveal or a slow vertical slide to enhance the cinematic feeling.
design.layout: The design uses a heavy-top composition with an oversized hero image followed by a centered typographic section and a structured feature grid. Content is grouped in dark, low-contrast modules with generous vertical spacing and centered alignments.
